en.s: On 5 February AD 62, an earthquake of an estimated magnitude of between 5 and 6 and a maximum intensity of IX or X on the Mercalli scale struck the towns of Pompeii and Herculaneum, severely damaging them. The earthquake may have been a precursor to the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in AD 79, which destroyed the same two towns.

zh.s: 公元62年2月5日，地震袭击了庞贝和赫库兰尼姆两座城镇，估计震级为5至6级，麦加利烈度最高为IX级或X级，造成严重破坏。这场地震可能是公元79年维苏威火山喷发的前兆；那次喷发摧毁了同样两座城镇。

en.s: The Incident at the Gaoping Tombs was a coup d'état that took place on 5 February 249 in the state of Cao Wei during the Three Kingdoms period (220–280) of China. The parties involved were Sima Yi and Cao Shuang, who were both regents for the Cao Wei emperor Cao Fang, who was then about 17 years old.

zh.s: 高平陵之变发生于249年2月5日，是中国三国时期曹魏的一场政变。参与双方是司马懿和曹爽，两人当时都是曹魏皇帝曹芳的辅政大臣；曹芳年约17岁。

en.s: The Heiji rebellion (平治の乱, Heiji no ran; January 19 – February 5, 1160) was a short civil war between rival subjects of the cloistered Emperor Go-Shirakawa of Japan in 1160 fought in order to resolve a dispute about political power. It was preceded by the Hōgen Rebellion in 1156.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 平治之乱（平治の乱，Heiji no ran）是日本后白河法皇的两派臣属为解决政治权力争端而于1160年1月19日至2月5日爆发的一场短暂内战。1156年保元之乱是其前奏。

en.s: On 5 February 1265, the cardinals elected Gui Foucois as Pope Clement IV at a conclave in Perugia, in present-day Italy.

zh.s: 1265年2月5日，枢机主教在今意大利佩鲁贾举行的教皇选举中，选举居伊·富尔夸为教皇，即克莱孟四世。

en.s: The Battle of Falun (Swedish: Slaget om Falun) was the first battle of the Swedish War of Liberation that took place in Falun, Sweden on February 5, 1521. Swedish rebels under Gustav Vasa, who had just days earlier been proclaimed leader of the Dalecarlians against the Danes, raided Falun. The rebels, consisting of a few hundred poorly armed peasants and some noble officers, took the Danish forces in the town completely by surprise. The local fogde Kristoffer Olsson and a few others labelled as "traitors" were captured. Local shops run by German merchants were plundered, and the population taxed.

zh.s: 1521年2月5日，瑞典解放战争首场战斗发生于法伦。古斯塔夫·瓦萨数日前刚被推举为达拉纳人反抗丹麦的领袖，随即率起义军突袭法伦。几百名装备简陋的农民及一些贵族军官，使城内丹麦守军措手不及。地方行政官克里斯托弗·奥尔松和数名被视为“叛徒”的人被捕。起义军洗劫了德意志商人经营的商店，并向当地居民征税。

en.s: The siege of Orléans was the final key military engagement of the first French War of Religion. Having lost the Battle of Dreux the rebel Huguenots fell back with their remaining forces to the city. François, Duke of Guise, the only non-captive royal commander, moved to lay siege to the town, hoping its capitulation would bring about a total victory for the crowns forces.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 奥尔良围城战是第一次法国宗教战争最后一场重要军事交战。德勒战役中失利后，胡格诺派叛军退回城内，收拢残余兵力。弗朗索瓦·德·吉斯公爵是唯一未被俘虏的王室指挥官，他开始围攻奥尔良，希望对方投降能让王室取得彻底胜利。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Krško was an engagement during the Croatian–Slovene Peasant Revolt of 1573.

zh.s: 克尔什科战役是1573年克罗地亚—斯洛文尼亚农民起义期间的一场交战。

en.s: On 5 February 1597, twenty-six Catholics were executed by crucifixion in Nagasaki, Japan. They later became known as the Twenty-six Martyrs of Japan.

zh.t: 二十六名天主教徒在长崎被处死
zh.s: 1597年2月5日，二十六名天主教徒在日本长崎被钉上十字架处死，后来被称为日本二十六殉道者。

en.s: The Battle of Lekkerbeetje or Lekkerbeetken (5 February 1600) was a cavalry duel fought by pre-arrangement on Vughterheide near 's-Hertogenbosch, North Brabant, between 22 Brabantine cavalrymen loyal to Albert VII, Archduke of Austria, garrisoned in 's-Hertogenbosch, and 22 French cavalrymen serving in the army of the Dutch Republic.

zh.s: 1600年2月5日，双方预先约定在北布拉班特斯海尔托亨博斯附近的菲赫特荒原进行一场骑兵决斗，称为莱克贝特耶之战。双方各22人：一方是驻扎斯海尔托亨博斯、效忠奥地利大公阿尔布雷希特七世的布拉班特骑兵，另一方则是为荷兰共和国军队服役的法国骑兵。

en.s: The Battle of Kup (part of the Vadda Ghalughara, meaning "greater massacre") was fought on 5 February 1762, between the Afghan forces of Ahmad Shah Durrani and the Sikhs, under the command of Jassa Singh Ahluwalia and Charat Singh. Ahmad Shah Durrani and the Afghan forces reached Malerkotla, west of Sirhind. They were met by between 30,000 and 50,000 Sikhs.

zh.s: 库普战役是瓦达大屠杀（意为“大屠杀”）的一部分，于1762年2月5日爆发，交战双方是艾哈迈德·沙·杜兰尼率领的阿富汗军队与锡克人。锡克军队由贾萨·辛格·阿卢瓦利亚和查拉特·辛格指挥。艾哈迈德·沙·杜兰尼及其部队抵达西尔欣德以西的马莱尔科特拉，遭遇3万至5万名锡克人。

en.s: The Battle of Sans Culottes Camp (5 February 1794) saw a Spanish Royal army commanded by José de Urrutia y de las Casas attack part of the Republican French Army of the Western Pyrenees under Jean-Henri-Guy-Nicolas de Frégeville. The Spanish assault seized two key positions behind the Bidasoa River but was unable to overrun the main position, called Sans Culottes Camp after an eight-hour contest. The War of the Pyrenees action was fought at a location described as being "in front" (that is, west of) of Saint-Jean-de-Luz near the modern border between Spain and France.

zh.s: 1794年2月5日，何塞·德·乌鲁蒂亚-德拉斯卡萨斯率领西班牙王室军队，进攻让-亨利-居伊-尼古拉·德·弗雷热维尔指挥的法国共和国西比利牛斯军团一部。西军夺取比达索阿河后方两处关键阵地，但经过八小时战斗，仍未攻下称为“无套裤汉营地”的主要阵地。这场比利牛斯战争中的战斗，发生于圣让德吕兹“前方”、即其西侧，靠近今天的西法边界。

en.s: The Siege of Cádiz was a siege of the large Spanish naval base of Cádiz by a French army from 5 February 1810 to 24 August 1812 during the Peninsular War. Following the occupation of Seville, Cádiz became the Spanish seat of power, and was targeted by 70,000 French troops under the command of the Marshals Claude Victor and Nicolas Jean-de-Dieu Soult for one of the most important sieges of the war. Defending the city were 2,000 Spanish troops who, as the siege progressed, received aid from 10,000 Spanish reinforcements as well as British and Portuguese troops.

zh.s: 半岛战争期间，法军于1810年2月5日至1812年8月24日围攻西班牙大型海军基地加的斯。塞维利亚沦陷后，加的斯成为西班牙政权所在地，克洛德·维克托和尼古拉·让·德迪厄·苏尔特两位元帅率七万法军围攻，形成战争中最重要的围城战之一。守城部队起初有2000名西班牙士兵，围城期间又得到一万名西班牙援军，以及英国、葡萄牙军队支援。

en.s: The Callao uprising (Spanish: Sublevación del Callao), also known as the Callao mutiny (Spanish: Motín del Callao), took place on February 5, 1824, in the Real Felipe Fortress in Callao, during the campaigns of Simón Bolívar in the Peruvian War of Independence, when Chilean, Colombian, Peruvian and Argentine units of the Army of the Andes rose up and crossed to the Spanish side, ending the unit's existence.

zh.s: 1824年2月5日，秘鲁独立战争中西蒙·玻利瓦尔作战期间，卡亚俄皇家费利佩要塞发生兵变。安第斯军中的智利、哥伦比亚、秘鲁和阿根廷部队起事，转投西班牙一方，安第斯军也由此不复存在。

en.t: 1833 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1833 United States Senate election in New York was held on February 5, 1833, by the New York State Legislature. Interim Senator Charles E. Dudley was not put forward for re-election to a full term. Jacksonian Nathaniel P. Tallmadge was elected to succeed him after narrowly winning a Jacksonian legislative caucus over Benjamin F. Butler. He then narrowly won majorities in both houses of the legislature.

zh.s: 1833年2月5日，纽约州议会举行美国参议员选举。临时参议员查尔斯·E·达德利没有获提名竞选完整任期。杰克逊派的纳撒尼尔·P·塔尔米奇击败本杰明·F·巴特勒，在党团会议中险胜后获选接替达德利。他随后在州议会两院都以微弱优势取得多数。

en.s: The Second Battle of Arquijas (February 5, 1835) was a battle of the First Carlist War. It followed the First Battle of Arquijas. The battle was a second attack on the positions of Carlist commander Tomás de Zumalacárregui at the pass at Arquijas, Navarre. Liberal commander Francisco Espoz y Mina sent 5,000 infantry and cavalrymen into the field. 9,000 Liberal troops were at Estella under Manuel Lorenzo, Marcelino de Oraá Lecumberri, and three other generals. Espoz y Mina gave orders for the passage of the Ega River at Arquijas. Meanwhile Zumalacárregui had 8,500 men. His generals were Ituralde, Guibelalde, Villareal, and Miguel Gómez Damas.

zh.t: 第二次阿尔基哈斯战役
zh.s: 第二次阿尔基哈斯战役发生于1835年2月5日，是第一次卡洛斯战争中继首战之后，再次进攻托马斯·德·苏马拉卡雷吉在纳瓦拉阿尔基哈斯隘口阵地的战斗。自由派指挥官弗朗西斯科·埃斯波斯·米纳派出5000名步兵和骑兵；另有9000名自由派士兵驻在埃斯特利亚，由曼努埃尔·洛伦索、马塞利诺·德·奥拉阿·莱昆韦里及另外三名将军指挥。米纳命令部队在阿尔基哈斯渡过埃加河。苏马拉卡雷吉则有8500人，部将包括伊图拉尔德、吉韦拉尔德、比利亚雷亚尔和米格尔·戈麦斯·达马斯。

en.t: 1839–1840 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1839—1840 United States Senate election in New York was held on February 5, 1839, and January 14, 1840. Incumbent Senator Nathaniel P. Tallmadge was re-elected to a second term in office over scattered opposition. Though his first election was as a Jacksonian Democrat, Tallmadge left the Democrats in 1838 to join a "Conservative" faction in support of the new Whig Party ticket led by William Seward.

zh.s: 纽约州在1839年2月5日及1840年1月14日举行联邦参议员选举。现任参议员纳撒尼尔·P.塔尔米奇面对分散的反对力量，获连任并开始第二个任期。他最初以杰克逊派民主党人身份当选，但于1838年离开民主党，加入支持威廉·西沃德领导的新辉格党候选人阵容的“保守派”。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 5 February 1844. General Francisco Malespín ran unopposed and was elected by the legislature. Malespín was sworn in on 7 February 1844 and served until 15 February 1845, when he was deposed by his vice president Joaquín Eufrasio Guzmán.

zh.s: 萨尔瓦多于1844年2月5日举行总统选举。弗朗西斯科·马莱斯平将军在没有竞争对手的情况下，由议会选为总统。他于2月7日宣誓就职，任至1845年2月15日，被自己的副总统华金·欧弗拉西奥·古斯曼推翻。

en.s: The Battle of Branyiszkó was a battle in the Hungarian war of Independence of 1848–1849, fought on 5 February 1849 between the revolutionary Hungarian division led by Colonel Richard Guyon against the detachment of the Austrian Empire led by Major General Franz Deym von Stritež, in the Pass of Branyiszkó.

zh.s: 1849年2月5日，1848—1849年匈牙利独立战争期间，理查德·居永上校率领的匈牙利革命军一个师，与弗朗茨·戴姆·冯·施特里特日少将率领的奥地利帝国分遣队，在布拉尼斯科隘口交战。

en.t: New Hermitage opens to the public
en.s: On 5 February 1852 in the Julian calendar, the New Hermitage opened to the public in Saint Petersburg, Russia. The date corresponds to February 17 in the Gregorian calendar.
en.n: February 5 follows the historical Julian calendar; the Gregorian equivalent is February 17, 1852.

zh.t: 新埃尔米塔日博物馆向公众开放
zh.s: 1852年儒略历2月5日，新埃尔米塔日博物馆在俄罗斯圣彼得堡向公众开放。这一天相当于公历2月17日。
zh.n: 2月5日沿用当时的儒略历，相当于公历1852年2月17日。

en.t: Alexandru Ioan Cuza elected prince of Wallachia
en.s: On 5 February 1859 in the Gregorian calendar, Alexandru Ioan Cuza was elected prince of Wallachia in Bucharest, in present-day Romania. He had already been elected prince of Moldavia, bringing the two principalities under one ruler.
en.n: February 5, 1859 is the Gregorian date, corresponding to January 24 in the Julian calendar.

zh.t: 库扎当选瓦拉几亚亲王
zh.s: 1859年公历2月5日，亚历山德鲁·约安·库扎在今罗马尼亚布加勒斯特当选瓦拉几亚亲王。他此前已当选摩尔达维亚亲王，两个公国由此有了同一位统治者。
zh.n: 公历1859年2月5日相当于儒略历1月24日。

en.t: 1861 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1861 United States Senate election in New York was held on February 5, 1861, by the New York State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 3) to represent the State of New York in the United States Senate.

zh.s: 1861年2月5日，纽约州议会举行联邦参议员选举，选出代表纽约州的第三组联邦参议员。

en.s: The Skirmish at Threlkeld's Ferry was an American Civil War engagement between Union Army and Confederate States Army cavalry detachments in northwest Arkansas on February 5, 1863 during a Union Army scout from Fayetteville, Arkansas to the Arkansas River. The skirmish resulted in a Union victory.

zh.t: 斯雷尔克尔德渡口战斗
zh.s: 1863年2月5日，美国内战期间，联邦军从阿肯色州费耶特维尔前往阿肯色河侦察，途中在该州西北部的斯雷尔克尔德渡口，与联盟军骑兵分遣队发生小规模交战。战斗以联邦军获胜告终。

en.t: The largest alluvial gold nugget in history, called the "Welcome Stranger", is found in Moliagul, Victoria, Australia
en.s: The Welcome Stranger was the largest alluvial gold nugget ever discovered. It was unearthed by Cornish miners John Deason and Richard Oates on 5 February 1869 in Moliagul, 9 miles (14 km) north-west of Dunolly in Victoria, Australia.

zh.s: “欢迎陌生人”是有史以来发现的最大块冲积金。1869年2月5日，康沃尔矿工约翰·迪森和理查德·奥茨在澳大利亚维多利亚州莫利亚古尔发现了这块金块。莫利亚古尔位于邓诺利西北9英里（14公里）处。

en.s: The 1897 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship final was the tenth All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 1897 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship, an inter-county Gaelic football tournament for the top teams in Ireland, played on 5 February 1899.

zh.t: 1897年全爱尔兰高级盖尔式足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1897年全爱尔兰高级盖尔式足球锦标赛决赛于1899年2月5日举行，是第十届全爱尔兰决赛，决定1897年赛事冠军。这项锦标赛由爱尔兰各郡顶尖球队参加。

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of East Down was held on 5 February 1902. It was caused by the incumbent MP, James Alexander Rentoul, becoming a judge and resigning as Member of Parliament. The result saw James Wood, the Russellite candidate, beat the Irish Unionist candidate.

zh.s: 英国议会东唐选区于1902年2月5日举行补选。现任议员詹姆斯·亚历山大·伦图尔获任法官并辞去议席，因而触发补选。拉塞尔派候选人詹姆斯·伍德击败爱尔兰统一派候选人，赢得选举。

en.s: On February 5, 1905, President Porfirio Díaz inaugurated the General Hospital of Mexico in Mexico City. Construction had begun in 1896.

zh.t: 墨西哥总医院落成启用
zh.s: 1905年2月5日，墨西哥总统波菲里奥·迪亚斯为位于墨西哥城的墨西哥总医院主持启用仪式。医院于1896年开始建设。

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Queensland on 5 February 1908 to elect the 72 members of the state's Legislative Assembly. The election, held less than 9 months after the previous election, was made necessary by a series of events which had seen former premier William Kidston, who commanded a majority on the floor of the Assembly, resign following an attempt to convince the governor of Queensland to appoint sympathetic members to the Queensland Legislative Council, which had blocked key legislative measures.

zh.s: 1908年2月5日，澳大利亚昆士兰州举行选举，改选州立法议会72名议员。此次选举距离上次选举不到9个月，是一连串事件的结果：前州长威廉·基德斯顿在试图说服昆士兰州总督任命支持自己的议员进入州立法会后辞职；立法会此前阻止了多项重要法案。

en.t: Monteverdi’s L’incoronazione di Poppea staged in Paris
en.s: On 5 February 1913, Vincent d’Indy’s version of Monteverdi’s opera L’incoronazione di Poppea was staged at the Théâtre des Arts in Paris, France. D’Indy had previously conducted a concert version in 1905.

zh.s: 1913年2月5日，蒙特威尔第的歌剧《波佩亚的加冕》在法国巴黎艺术剧院上演，采用樊尚·丹第改编的版本。丹第此前曾于1905年指挥这部作品的音乐会演出。

en.s: The current Constitution of Mexico, formally the Political Constitution of the United Mexican States (Spanish: Constitución Política de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos), was drafted in Santiago de Querétaro, in the State of Querétaro, Mexico, by a constituent convention during the Mexican Revolution. It was approved by the Constituent Congress on 5 February 1917, and was later amended several times.

zh.s: 墨西哥现行宪法正式名称为《墨西哥合众国政治宪法》，由制宪会议在墨西哥革命期间，于克雷塔罗州圣地亚哥-德克雷塔罗起草。制宪国会于1917年2月5日通过该宪法，此后又多次修订。

en.s: The Battle of Kyiv started in January 1919 and was one of a number of battles fought over the capital of Ukraine during the Russian Civil War and Ukrainian–Soviet War. It involved an offensive by elements of the Ukrainian Front of the Red Army to capture Kyiv. The battle was a part of the General Offensive of the Ukrainian Front.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 基辅战役始于1919年1月，是俄罗斯内战和乌克兰—苏俄战争期间围绕乌克兰首都基辅发生的多场战斗之一。红军乌克兰方面军部分部队发动攻势，试图攻占基辅。该战役是乌克兰方面军总攻的一部分。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Berne International, by its opponents also known as the Yellow International, was a Socialist International formed in Bern, Switzerland 3–9 February 1919. Its goal was to re-establish the Second International. However it did not support world revolution and rejected involvement with the Communist International.

zh.s: 伯尔尼国际（反对者也称其为“黄色国际”）是一个社会主义国际组织，于1919年2月3日至9日在瑞士伯尔尼成立。该组织旨在重建第二国际，但不支持世界革命，也拒绝参与共产国际。

en.s: The 1923 Quebec general election was held on February 5, 1923, to elect members of the 16th Legislative Assembly of Quebec, Canada. The incumbent Quebec Liberal Party, led by Louis-Alexandre Taschereau, was re-elected, defeating the Quebec Conservative Party, led by Arthur Sauvé. It was the first of four election victories in a row for Taschereau. However, he had held office since 1920, following the resignation of the previous premier, Lomer Gouin.

zh.s: 1923年2月5日，加拿大魁北克省举行大选，选出魁北克第16届立法议会议员。由路易-亚历山大·塔舍罗领导的魁北克自由党连任成功，击败由阿瑟·索韦领导的魁北克保守党。这是塔舍罗连续四次赢得选举中的第一次。不过，他自1920年洛默·古安辞去省长后就已执政。

en.s: The Battle of Kosmach (Ukrainian: Бої під Космачем; 30 January — 5 February, 1945) was fought between the 31st, 33rd, 87th Frontier Detachments, 256th Regiment of the NKVD in the Ministry of the Internal Affairs of the Soviet Union under the command of Aleksey Dergachev against the Armed Units “Skazheni”, “Hutsulskyi”, “Haydamaky” and “Pidkarpatskyi” of the 4th Operational Group “Hoverla” in the Western Operational Group of the Ukrainian Insurgent Army under the command of Myroslav Symsych and Pavlo Vatsyk in the Kosiv Raion of the Stanislav Oblast.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 科斯马奇战役（乌克兰语：Бої під Космачем）于1945年1月30日至2月5日在斯坦尼斯拉夫州科西夫区爆发。苏联内务部下属的第31、第33和第87边防分队及内务人民委员部第256团，由阿列克谢·杰尔加乔夫指挥，与乌克兰起义军西部作战集群“霍韦尔拉”第4作战组下属的“狂暴者”“胡楚尔人”“海达马克”和“喀尔巴阡人”武装部队交战，后者由米罗斯拉夫·西姆西奇和帕夫洛·瓦齐克指挥。

en.s: Polish presidential election, 1947 took place on February 5, 1947 and it was the last presidential election in Poland before 1989. The president had to be elected by the newly formed Legislative Sejm among presented candidates. Hovewer, the only standing figure was Bolesław Bierut. Opposition Polish People's Party voted against.

zh.s: 波兰于1947年2月5日举行总统选举，这是1989年以前最后一次总统选举。总统由新成立的立法瑟姆从提出的候选人中选出，但实际只有博莱斯瓦夫·贝鲁特一名候选人。反对党波兰人民党投了反对票。

en.s: The Battle of Ciseupan (Indonesian: Pertempuran Ciseupan) was a clash between Indonesian nationalists from the Siliwangi Division and Dutch forces. The Dutch launched an attack on the village of Ciseupan, West Java, Indonesia with the objective of ambushing the Indonesian nationalists that were resting in the village during their long march.

zh.s: 奇塞乌潘战役（印度尼西亚语：Pertempuran Ciseupan）是印度尼西亚民族主义者与荷兰军队之间的一次交战。印度尼西亚民族主义者来自西里旺义师。荷兰军队袭击了印度尼西亚西爪哇的奇塞乌潘村，意图伏击在长途行军期间于村中休息的民族主义者。

en.s: The Tybee Island mid-air collision was an incident on February 5, 1958, in which the United States Air Force lost a 7,600-pound (3,400 kg) Mark 15 nuclear bomb in the waters of Tybee Island near Savannah, Georgia, United States. During a night practice exercise, an F-86 fighter plane collided with the B-47 bomber carrying the large weapon. The bomb was jettisoned to help prevent a crash and explosion.

zh.s: 1958年2月5日，美国空军一架F-86战斗机在夜间训练中与一架搭载大型武器的B-47轰炸机相撞。为避免飞机坠毁和爆炸，机组人员将一枚重7600磅（3400公斤）的Mark 15核弹投下，核弹落入美国佐治亚州萨凡纳附近泰比岛一带海域。

en.t: 1963 Mississippi House of Representatives special election in Lauderdale County
en.s: Lauderdale County in Mississippi held a special election on February 5, 1963, and February 19, 1963, to elect a new member of the Mississippi House of Representatives. The election filled the 11-month remainder of incumbent Democratic representative Natie Caraway's term, who resigned on January 1, 1963, after relocating to Jackson. Lewis McAllister won the seat during the February 19 runoff, flipping the seat to the Republicans.

zh.t: 1963年劳德代尔县密西西比州众议员特别选举
zh.s: 密西西比州劳德代尔县于1963年2月5日及19日举行特别选举，选出一名新州众议员，接续民主党现任议员内蒂·卡拉韦剩余11个月的任期。卡拉韦迁居杰克逊后，于1月1日辞职。刘易斯·麦卡利斯特在2月19日的第二轮投票中获胜，使该席位转由共和党掌握。

en.s: The Battle of Bến Tre took place during the Tet Offensive of the Vietnam War when Vietcong (VC) forces attacked Bến Tre, the capital of Kien Hoa Province, on 31 January 1968. The battle lasted until 5 February when U.S. and South Vietnamese forces ejected the VC who suffered 328 killed.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 槟椥战役发生在越南战争期间的春节攻势中。1968年1月31日，越共部队袭击坚和省省会槟椥。战斗持续到2月5日，美军和南越军队将越共部队击退；越共方面有328人死亡。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Elections to the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly were held in February 1969, to elect members of the 425 constituencies in Uttar Pradesh, India. The Indian National Congress won the most seats as well as the popular vote, and Chandra Bhanu Gupta was appointed the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh. The state had been under President's Rule since February 1968.

zh.s: 1969年2月，印度北方邦举行立法议会选举，改选425个选区的议员。印度国民大会党赢得最多席位和普选票，钱德拉·巴努·古普塔获任北方邦首席部长。该邦自1968年2月起一直由总统直接统治。

en.s: Hereford United v Newcastle United was a football match played on 5 February 1972 at Edgar Street, Hereford. The match was an FA Cup third round replay after the first match had resulted in a 2–2 draw. The result, a 2–1 extra time victory for Hereford, is notable for being one of the tournament's greatest ever shocks, as Hereford were the lowest-ranked non-league side to beat a top-flight opposition in English footballing history.

zh.t: 赫里福德联2比1纽卡斯尔联
zh.s: 赫里福德联对纽卡斯尔联的足球比赛于1972年2月5日在赫里福德的埃德加街球场举行。这是足总杯第三轮重赛，首场比赛以2比2结束。赫里福德联在加时赛以2比1获胜，成为赛事历史上最令人意外的胜利之一；该队是英格兰足球史上击败顶级联赛球队的最低级别非联赛球队。

en.s: Baron 52 was the call sign of a United States Air Force EC-47 carrying eight crew members that was shot down over Laos during the predawn hours of 5 February 1973, a week after the Paris Peace Accords officially ended the United States involvement in the Vietnam War. The remains of four crewmen were recovered from the crash site, but those of the remaining four have never been found.

zh.s: 1973年2月5日凌晨，美国空军一架呼号为“男爵52”号的EC-47飞机在老挝上空被击落，机上有8名机组人员。事发一周前，《巴黎和平协定》正式结束了美国对越南战争的介入。搜寻人员从坠机地点找回4名机组人员的遗骸，另外4人的遗骸至今未找到。

en.s: The Limazo (from Lima and the Spanish suffix azo, meaning blow or violent), also known as the Febrerazo, was a police strike and citywide unrest that occurred in Lima, beginning on February 3, 1975. The unrest was allegedly instigated by the CIA and APRA, and was violently suppressed by the Peruvian Armed Forces by February 5.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 利马骚乱（Limazo，也称Febrerazo）一词由利马和西班牙语后缀azo（意为打击或暴力事件）组成，指1975年2月3日开始的警察罢工和全城骚乱。有人称骚乱由中央情报局和美洲人民革命联盟煽动。到2月5日，秘鲁武装部队以暴力手段镇压了骚乱。

en.s: General elections were held in Costa Rica on February 5, 1978. Rodrigo Carazo Odio of the Unity Coalition won the presidential election, whilst his party also won the parliamentary election. Voter turnout was 81%. Carazo, former Congressman and former member of National Liberation Party (probably Costa Rica’s main political force) left the party several years before and created his own: Democratic Renovation, but a deeply split opposition on the 1974 election caused PLN’s easy victory. With that in mind, main leaders of the non-Marxist opposition started talks in order to present a unified candidature.

zh.s: 哥斯达黎加于1978年2月5日举行大选。团结联盟的罗德里戈·卡拉索·奥迪奥赢得总统选举，其所属联盟也赢得议会选举，投票率为81%。卡拉索曾任国会议员，也是该国主要政治力量民族解放党的前成员。他几年前退党，另建民主革新党。但1974年选举中，反对派严重分裂，使民族解放党轻松获胜。鉴于这一教训，非马克思主义反对派的主要领袖开始协商，争取推出统一候选人。

en.t: 1978 Ontario New Democratic Party leadership election
en.s: The 1978 Ontario New Democratic Party leadership election was held in Toronto, Ontario, on February 5, 1978, to elect a successor to Stephen Lewis as leader of the Ontario New Democratic Party (NDP). The convention was necessary because Lewis resigned after the party performed poorly in the 1977 Ontario provincial election, where they had dropped to third place in the Legislative Assembly of Ontario.

zh.t: 1978年安大略新民主党党魁选举
zh.s: 安大略新民主党于1978年2月5日在安大略省多伦多举行党魁选举，选出斯蒂芬·刘易斯的继任者。该党在1977年省议会选举中表现不佳，降至议会第三大党，刘易斯因此辞职，随后举行此次大会。

en.s: Operation Soap was a raid by the Metropolitan Toronto Police against four gay bathhouses in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, which took place on February 5, 1981. Nearly three hundred men were arrested, the largest mass arrest in Canada since the 1970 October crisis, before the record was broken during the 2006 Stanley Cup Playoffs in Edmonton, Alberta.

zh.s: 1981年2月5日，加拿大多伦多都会警察突袭安大略省多伦多的四家男同性恋浴场，逮捕近300名男子。这是加拿大自1970年十月危机以来规模最大的集体逮捕，直到2006年阿尔伯塔省埃德蒙顿斯坦利杯季后赛期间，这一纪录才被打破。

en.s: Operation Tiburon, (Tiburon (es:Tiburón) is Spanish for "Shark,") was a coordinated counterdrug operation between three different U.S. agencies – Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA), U.S. Coast Guard, U.S. Customs Service – and Colombian authorities, resulting in the seizure of approximately 6.4 million pounds of marijuana coming from Colombia, about 20% of the total amount that enters the United States annually.

zh.s: “鲨鱼”行动（西班牙语Tiburón意为“鲨鱼”）是美国缉毒局、海岸警卫队、海关总署与哥伦比亚当局联合开展的禁毒行动，查获了约640万磅从哥伦比亚运来的大麻，约占每年进入美国的大麻总量的20%。

en.s: The 1987 Afro-Asian Club Championship, was the 2nd Afro-Asian Club Championship competition endorsed by the Confederation of African Football (CAF) and Asian Football Confederation (AFC), contested between the winners of the African Champions' Cup and the Asian Club Championship. This was the last time the game was contested over a single match; from 1988 until 1998 the competition was held in a two-legged tie format. The match took place on 5 February 1988, in Cairo Stadium in Cairo, Egypt.

zh.s: 1987年亚非俱乐部锦标赛是该赛事的第二届，由非洲足球联合会（CAF）和亚洲足球联合会（AFC）认可，参赛球队为非洲冠军杯和亚洲俱乐部锦标赛的冠军。这是赛事最后一次采用单场决胜制；1988年至1998年改为两回合比赛。决赛于1988年2月5日在埃及开罗体育场举行。

en.t: New Orleans holds first round of mayoral election
en.s: On February 5, 1994, New Orleans, Louisiana, United States, held the first round of its mayoral election. A runoff followed on March 5.

zh.t: 新奥尔良市长选举举行首轮投票
zh.s: 1994年2月5日，美国路易斯安那州新奥尔良举行市长选举首轮投票，第二轮投票于3月5日举行。

en.s: The 1995 Socialist Party presidential primary was the selection process by which members of the Socialist Party of France chose their candidate for the 1995 French presidential election. Lionel Jospin won the primary by a huge margin. He later lost the presidential election to conservative candidate Jacques Chirac on 7 May 1995, obtaining 47% of the vote in the runoff.

zh.s: 1995年法国社会党总统初选是该党成员选出1995年法国总统选举候选人的程序。利昂内尔·若斯潘以大幅优势赢得初选，后来在5月7日举行的总统选举第二轮中输给保守派候选人雅克·希拉克，获得47%的选票。

en.s: The 1996 Whitehorse West territorial by-election took place on February 5, 1996. The by-election was triggered by the resignation of the district's incumbent MLA Tony Penikett on September 27, 1995. NDP candidate David Sloan won the by-election.

zh.s: 1996年怀特霍斯西区补选于1996年2月5日举行。该选区现任议员托尼·佩尼基特于1995年9月27日辞职，因此触发补选。新民主党候选人大卫·斯隆赢得选举。

en.s: The Novye Aldi massacre was the mass murder of Chechen civilians on February 5, 2000, in which Russian forces went on a cleansing operation (zachistka), summarily executing dozens. The village had been cluster-bombed a day prior to the massacre, and local residents urged to come out for inspection the next day. Upon entering the village, Russian forces shot their victims with automatic fire at close range.

zh.s: 2000年2月5日，俄罗斯军队在诺维耶阿尔迪村开展“清剿行动”（俄语：зачистка），当场处决数十名车臣平民，造成大规模杀戮。前一天，该村遭集束炸弹轰炸。次日，当地居民被要求出来接受检查，俄军进入村庄后在近距离用自动武器射杀受害者。

en.s: On the evening of 5 February 2004, at least 22 Chinese labourers were drowned by an incoming tide at Morecambe Bay in Lancashire, North West England, while illegally harvesting cockles off the coast. Fifteen other labourers from the same group managed to return safely to shore. During the investigation and trial, it emerged that the labourers had immigrated illegally, were inexperienced, spoke little or no English and were unfamiliar with the area.

zh.s: 2004年2月5日晚，至少22名中国劳工在英格兰西北部兰开夏郡的莫克姆湾非法采蛤时，遭遇涨潮溺亡。同组另有15名劳工安全返回岸边。调查和审判期间查明，这些劳工是非法移民，缺乏经验，几乎不会说英语，也不熟悉当地情况。

en.s: UFC 51: Super Saturday was a mixed martial arts event held by the Ultimate Fighting Championship on February 5, 2005 (Super Bowl weekend) at the Mandalay Bay Events Center in Las Vegas, Nevada. The event was broadcast live on pay-per-view in the United States and Canada, and later released on DVD.

zh.s: UFC 51：超级星期六，是终极格斗冠军赛于2005年2月5日、超级碗周末，在美国内华达州拉斯维加斯曼德勒海湾活动中心举办的综合格斗赛事。比赛在美国和加拿大以按次付费方式直播，之后发行了DVD。

en.s: The 2005 Togolese coup d'état was the unconstitutional seizure of power by the military in Togo through the appointment of Faure Gnassingbe, son of long-time President Gnassingbe Eyadema, who had ruled the country for 38 years after leading a coup d'état of his own in 1967. On February 5, 2005, President Eyadema suddenly died of a heart attack.

zh.s: 2005年2月5日，多哥总统纳辛贝·埃亚德马突然因心脏病去世，军方违宪任命他的儿子福雷·纳辛贝掌权，形成一场政变。埃亚德马自己也曾在1967年发动政变，此后统治多哥38年。

en.s: General elections were held in Costa Rica on February 5, 2006. In the presidential election, Óscar Arias of the National Liberation Party (Partido Liberación Nacional), a former president and Nobel Peace Laureate, was victorious over Ottón Solís of the Citizens' Action Party (Partido Acción Ciudadana) and twelve other minor-party candidates. Although Arias was expected to win by a wide margin, the actual polling reports were unexpectedly close. However, early results showed the contest to be closer than it actually was. The preliminary official report, after 88.45% of the vote counted, showed the result for President of the Republic almost tied between Arias with 40.51% of the vote and Ottón Solís with 40.29%.

zh.s: 哥斯达黎加于2006年2月5日举行大选。民族解放党候选人、前总统兼诺贝尔和平奖得主奥斯卡·阿里亚斯，击败公民行动党的奥顿·索利斯及另外12名小党候选人，赢得总统选举。外界原预计阿里亚斯会大幅领先，实际计票结果却意外接近。不过，早期结果又比最终差距更小。在计完88.45%的选票后，初步官方报告显示，阿里亚斯获得40.51%，索利斯获得40.29%，两人几乎打平。

en.s: The 27th Yokohama Film Festival (第27回ヨコハマ映画祭) was held on 5 February 2006 in Kannai Hall, Yokohama, Kanagawa, Japan.

zh.s: 第27届横滨电影节于2006年2月5日在日本神奈川县横滨市关内大厅举行。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held on 5 February 2006 to elect the next governor of Nagasaki (山口県, Nagasaki-ken), a prefecture of Japan in the north-west of the island of Kyushu.

zh.s: 日本长崎县于2006年2月5日举行知事选举。长崎县位于九州岛西北部。原文括注误写为“山口县”，与标题和其余内容不符。

en.s: The "Battle of Omagh" was a football match of Ireland's National League, played at Healy Park in Omagh, on Sunday, 5 February 2006 between Dublin and the 2005 All-Ireland SFC champions Tyrone. The final score, of 1–9 to 1–6, was in favour of Dublin. The highlights of the match included the sendings-off of Dublin's Alan Brogan and Tyrone's Colin Holmes and, subsequently, Dublin's Denis Bastick and Tyrone's Stephen O'Neill after both received second yellow cards.

zh.s: 2006年2月5日星期日，都柏林队与2005年全爱尔兰高级橄榄球锦标赛冠军蒂龙队在奥马的希利公园进行爱尔兰全国联赛。都柏林队以1比9对1比6获胜。比赛中，都柏林队的艾伦·布罗根和蒂龙队的科林·霍姆斯被罚下，随后两队的丹尼斯·巴斯蒂克和斯蒂芬·奥尼尔也因各领第二张黄牌被罚下。

en.s: The Massachusetts Democratic Presidential Primary took place on Super Tuesday, February 5, 2008, and had a total of 93 delegates at stake. The winner in each of Massachusetts's 10 congressional districts was awarded all of that district's delegates, totaling 61. Another 32 delegates were awarded to the statewide winner, Hillary Clinton. The 93 delegates represented Massachusetts at the Democratic National Convention in Denver, Colorado. Twenty-six other unpledged delegates, known as superdelegates, also attended the convention and cast their votes as well.

zh.t: 2008年马萨诸塞州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 马萨诸塞州民主党总统初选于2008年2月5日“超级星期二”举行，共争夺93个代表名额。原文记载，该州十个国会选区的胜者各获得所在选区全部名额，合计61名代表；全州胜者希拉里·克林顿另获得32个名额。这93名代表参加在科罗拉多州丹佛举行的民主党全国代表大会。另外26名不承诺支持特定候选人的“超级代表”也出席大会并投票。

en.s: The Massachusetts Republican Primary took place on February 5, 2008, with 40 national delegates. Polls indicated that former Governor of Massachusetts Mitt Romney was leading rival John McCain; Romney ended up defeating McCain by roughly 10% of the vote.

zh.t: 2008年马萨诸塞州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 马萨诸塞州共和党总统初选于2008年2月5日举行，争夺40个全国代表名额。民调显示，该州前州长米特·罗姆尼领先对手约翰·麦凯恩。最终罗姆尼以约十个百分点的得票优势获胜。

en.s: The 2008 Connecticut Democratic presidential primary took place on Super Tuesday, February 5, 2008, with 48 delegates at stake. The winner in each of Connecticut's five congressional districts was awarded all of that district's delegates, totaling 31. Another 17 delegates were awarded to the statewide winner, Barack Obama. The 48 delegates represented Connecticut at the Democratic National Convention in Denver, Colorado.

zh.t: 2008年康涅狄格州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年康涅狄格州民主党总统初选于2月5日“超级星期二”举行，争夺48个代表名额。原文记载，五个国会选区的胜者各获得所在选区全部名额，合计31个；全州胜者贝拉克·奥巴马另获得17个名额。这48名代表参加在科罗拉多州丹佛举行的民主党全国代表大会。

en.s: The 2008 Tennessee Democratic presidential primary took place on February 5, 2008, also known as Super Tuesday. The primary determined 58 delegates to the 2008 Democratic National Convention, who were awarded on a proportional basis. Hillary Clinton won with 53.82% of the vote and was awarded 40 delegates. Barack Obama placed second, getting 40.48% of the vote and was awarded 28 delegates.

zh.t: 2008年田纳西州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年田纳西州民主党总统初选于2月5日“超级星期二”举行，代表名额按得票比例分配。希拉里·克林顿获得53.82%的选票，分得40个名额；贝拉克·奥巴马以40.48%的得票率排名第二，分得28个名额。原文开头称本次分配58个代表名额，与后文列出的40加28个名额不一致。

en.s: The 2008 California Republican presidential primary was held on February 5, 2008, with a total of 173 national delegates at stake.

zh.t: 2008年加利福尼亚州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州于2008年2月5日举行共和党总统初选，共争夺173个全国代表名额。

en.s: The 2008 Alabama Democratic presidential primary was held on Super Tuesday, February 5, 2008, and had a total of 52 delegates at stake. The winner in each of Alabama's seven congressional districts was awarded all of that district's delegates, totaling 34. Another 18 delegates were awarded to the statewide winner, Barack Obama. The 52 delegates represented Alabama at the Democratic National Convention in Denver, Colorado.

zh.t: 2008年阿拉巴马州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年阿拉巴马州民主党总统初选于2月5日“超级星期二”举行，争夺52个代表名额。原文记载，七个国会选区的胜者各获得所在选区全部名额，合计34个；全州胜者贝拉克·奥巴马另获得18个名额。这52名代表参加在科罗拉多州丹佛举行的民主党全国代表大会。

en.s: The 2008 Tennessee Republican presidential primary took place on February 5, 2008 (Super Tuesday), with 52 national delegates. Mike Huckabee narrowly defeated John McCain to win the largest share of Tennessee's delegates to the 2008 Republican National Convention. Both McCain and the third-place candidate Mitt Romney received delegates along with Huckabee.

zh.t: 2008年田纳西州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年田纳西州共和党总统初选于2月5日“超级星期二”举行，分配52个全国代表名额。迈克·赫卡比险胜约翰·麦凯恩，获得该州参加共和党全国代表大会的最多名额。麦凯恩及排名第三的米特·罗姆尼也分得了代表名额。

en.s: The 2008 Utah Democratic presidential primary took place on February 5, 2008, with the votes of 23 pledged delegates to the 2008 Democratic National Convention at stake. The primary was one of many held on Super Tuesday. Barack Obama won the primary.

zh.s: 犹他州于2008年2月5日举行民主党总统初选，是“超级星期二”众多初选之一，争夺23个承诺支持特定候选人的民主党全国代表大会代表名额。贝拉克·奥巴马赢得初选。

en.s: The 2008 New Jersey Republican presidential primary took place on February 5, 2008, with 52 national delegates.

zh.t: 2008年新泽西州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 新泽西州于2008年2月5日举行共和党总统初选，分配52个全国代表名额。

en.s: The 2008 Arizona Democratic presidential primary took place on Super Tuesday, February 5, 2008, and had a total of 56 delegates at stake. The winner in each of Arizona's eight congressional districts was awarded all of that district's delegates, which totaled 37. Another 19 delegates were awarded to the statewide winner, Hillary Clinton. The 56 delegates represented Arizona at the Democratic National Convention in Denver, Colorado.

zh.t: 2008年亚利桑那州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年亚利桑那州民主党总统初选于2月5日“超级星期二”举行，争夺56个代表名额。原文记载，八个国会选区的胜者各获得所在选区全部名额，合计37个；全州胜者希拉里·克林顿另获得19个名额。这56名代表参加在科罗拉多州丹佛举行的民主党全国代表大会。

en.s: The 2008 Illinois Democratic presidential primary took place on Super Tuesday, February 5, 2008, with 153 delegates at stake. Each of Illinois's 19 congressional districts was proportionally allocated to candidates who had received 15% or more of the vote in that district, totaling 100. Another 53 delegates were also proportionally allocated to candidates who had received 15% or more of the vote statewide.

zh.t: 2008年伊利诺伊州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年伊利诺伊州民主党总统初选于2月5日“超级星期二”举行，争夺153个代表名额。其中100个名额在全州19个国会选区内，按候选人得票比例分配，获得该区至少15%选票者才有资格；另外53个名额则按全州得票比例分配，同样设有15%的门槛。

en.s: The 2008 Delaware Democratic presidential primary was held on Super Tuesday, February 5, 2008, and had a total of 15 delegates at stake. The winner in each of Delaware's subdivisions was awarded those subdivisions' delegates, totaling 10. Another five delegates were awarded to the statewide winner, Barack Obama. The 15 delegates represented Delaware at the Democratic National Convention in Denver, Colorado.

zh.t: 2008年特拉华州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年特拉华州民主党总统初选于2月5日“超级星期二”举行，争夺15个代表名额。原文记载，各分区胜者获得该分区名额，合计十个；全州胜者贝拉克·奥巴马另获得五个名额。这15名代表参加在科罗拉多州丹佛举行的民主党全国代表大会。

en.s: The 2008 Arkansas Republican presidential primary took place on February 5, 2008, with 31 national delegates. Former Governor of Arkansas Mike Huckabee was the winner of this Primary.

zh.t: 2008年阿肯色州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 阿肯色州于2008年2月5日举行共和党总统初选，分配31个全国代表名额。该州前州长迈克·赫卡比获胜。

en.s: The 2008 Connecticut Republican presidential primary was held on February 5, 2008 (Super Tuesday) as the process by which the U.S. state of Connecticut selected the recipient of 27 of the state's 30 delegates to the Republican National Convention in the process to elect the Republican candidate for the 44th president of the United States. It was a closed primary, restricted to enrolled members of the Republican Party.

zh.t: 2008年康涅狄格州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年2月5日“超级星期二”，康涅狄格州举行共和党总统初选，在确定美国第44任总统的共和党候选人过程中，分配该州参加共和党全国代表大会的30个名额中的27个。这是仅限登记为共和党成员的选民参加的封闭初选。

en.s: The 2008 Missouri Democratic presidential primary took place on Super Tuesday, February 5, 2008, with 72 delegates at stake. The winner in each of Missouri's nine congressional districts was awarded all of that district's delegates, which totaled 47. Another 25 delegates were awarded to the statewide winner, Barack Obama. The 72 delegates represented Missouri at the Democratic National Convention in Denver, Colorado.

zh.t: 2008年密苏里州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年密苏里州民主党总统初选于2月5日“超级星期二”举行，争夺72个代表名额。原文记载，九个国会选区的胜者各获得所在选区全部名额，合计47个；全州胜者贝拉克·奥巴马另获得25个名额。这72名代表参加在科罗拉多州丹佛举行的民主党全国代表大会。

en.s: The 2008 New Mexico Democratic presidential primary took place on February 5, 2008, with 26 national delegates at stake. On February 12, 2008, counting was officially finished and Hillary Clinton was declared the winner.

zh.t: 2008年新墨西哥州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 新墨西哥州于2008年2月5日举行民主党总统初选，争夺26个全国代表名额。2月12日，官方完成计票，宣布希拉里·克林顿获胜。

en.s: The 2008 Missouri Republican presidential primary on February 5, 2008, determined the recipient of 55 of the state's 58 delegates to the Republican National Convention in the process to elect the 44th President of the United States. It was an open primary. John McCain won a slight plurality of the vote, receiving all of Missouri's delegates.

zh.t: 2008年密苏里州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年2月5日，密苏里州举行共和党总统初选，在确定美国第44任总统候选人的过程中，分配该州参加共和党全国代表大会的58个名额中的55个。这是一次开放初选。约翰·麦凯恩以微弱优势取得最高票数，获得本次分配的全部密苏里州代表名额。

en.t: 2008 Montana Republican presidential caucuses and primary
en.s: The 2008 Montana Republican presidential caucuses took place on February 5, 2008, with 25 national delegates. The first caucuses were scheduled for midday in Sheridan County and Judith Basin County. In the fall of 2007, Montana's Republican Party decided to create a caucus for Super Tuesday. They hoped to "boost the state's profile among the campaigns and energize the party."

zh.t: 2008年蒙大拿州共和党总统党团会议及初选
zh.s: 蒙大拿州共和党总统党团会议于2008年2月5日举行，分配25个全国代表名额。最早的会议安排在谢里登县和朱迪斯盆地县中午举行。2007年秋，蒙大拿州共和党决定在“超级星期二”增设党团会议，希望让竞选团队更加重视该州，并激发党内活力。

en.s: The 2008 New Jersey Democratic presidential primary took place February 5, 2008, also known as Super Tuesday. With 107 pledged delegates at stake, New Jersey was a significant battleground in the Democratic nomination race between Senators Hillary Clinton and Barack Obama. Hillary Clinton won the primary amid record-breaking turnout. Her margin of victory was narrower than early polling had projected but contradicted Barack Obama’s late surge in polling and strong performance in urban areas.

zh.t: 2008年新泽西州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 新泽西州民主党总统初选于2008年2月5日“超级星期二”举行。由于有107个承诺支持特定候选人的代表名额可争夺，该州成为希拉里·克林顿与贝拉克·奥巴马两位参议员争取提名的重要战场。投票参与人数创下纪录，克林顿最终获胜。她的领先幅度低于早期民调预测，但结果也未印证奥巴马在后期民调中迅速追近、并在城市地区表现强劲的势头。

en.s: The 2008 Arizona Republican presidential primary took place on February 5, 2008, with 50 national delegates. John McCain would be able to win his homestate against competitors Mitt Romney and Mike Huckabee.

zh.t: 2008年亚利桑那州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 亚利桑那州于2008年2月5日举行共和党总统初选，分配50个全国代表名额。约翰·麦凯恩在自己的家乡州，击败米特·罗姆尼和迈克·赫卡比，赢得初选。

en.s: The 2008 New York Democratic presidential primary took place on February 5, 2008, also known as Super Tuesday. Polls indicated that New York Senator Hillary Clinton was leading rival Senator Barack Obama by double digits in the weeks before the contest, and she ended up winning with roughly 57% of the vote. Clinton won every county in her home state except Tompkins County, home to the college town of Ithaca, which strongly supported Obama.

zh.s: 纽约州民主党总统初选于2008年2月5日“超级星期二”举行。投票前数周的民调显示，纽约州参议员希拉里·克林顿领先对手贝拉克·奥巴马两位数的百分点。她最终获得约57%的选票，并赢得自己所代表州的几乎所有县，唯一例外是汤普金斯县。该县的大学城伊萨卡强力支持奥巴马。

en.s: The 2008 Illinois Republican presidential primary was held on February 5, 2008. Illinois was one of 24 States holding a primary or caucus on Super Tuesday, 2008. Delegates from each of Illinois' 19 congressional districts are selected by direct election. In addition, the primary ballot also contains a preference poll that lists the presidential candidates. 10 at-large delegates and 3 party leader delegates were elected at the State Convention and officially went to the Republican Convention unpledged.

zh.t: 2008年伊利诺伊州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于2008年2月5日举行共和党总统初选，是当年“超级星期二”举行初选或党团会议的24个州之一。全州19个国会选区的代表通过直接选举产生，初选选票上也列出总统候选人，供选民表达支持意向。另外十名全州代表和三名党领袖代表在州党代会上选出，正式参加共和党全国代表大会时，不承诺支持特定候选人。

en.s: The 2008 Arkansas Democratic presidential primary took place on Super Tuesday, February 5, 2008, with 35 delegates at stake. The winner in each of Arkansas's four congressional districts was awarded all of that district's delegates, totaling 22. Another 13 delegates were awarded to the statewide winner, Hillary Clinton. The 35 delegates represented Arkansas at the Democratic National Convention in Denver, Colorado.

zh.t: 2008年阿肯色州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年阿肯色州民主党总统初选于2月5日“超级星期二”举行，争夺35个代表名额。原文记载，四个国会选区的胜者各获得所在选区全部名额，合计22个；全州胜者希拉里·克林顿另获得13个名额。这35名代表参加在科罗拉多州丹佛举行的民主党全国代表大会。

en.s: Elections were held in California on February 5, 2008. Presidential primaries and a special election for a State Assembly seat were among the contests held. Seven ballot propositions were also decided on.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州于2008年2月5日举行多项选举，包括总统初选及一个州众议院席位的特别选举。选民还就七项公投提案作出决定。

en.s: The 2008 Utah Republican presidential primary took place on February 5, 2008, with 36 national delegates. Polls showed Mitt Romney leading at up to 85% of the vote. On August 23, 2008, the Utah Republican Party adopted a standing rule effectively binding the delegates to John McCain for the first ballot at the National Convention (as Romney had withdrawn).

zh.s: 犹他州于2008年2月5日举行共和党总统初选，分配36个全国代表名额。民调显示，米特·罗姆尼支持率高达85%，明显领先。8月23日，由于罗姆尼已经退选，犹他州共和党通过一项常设规则，实际上要求该州代表在全国代表大会首轮投票中支持约翰·麦凯恩。

en.s: The 2008 California Democratic presidential primary took place on February 5, 2008, also known as Super Tuesday. California offered the most delegates out of any nominating contest. Hillary Clinton won the primary with 51.47% of the vote, winning 204 delegates, while Barack Obama got 43.16% of the vote and won 166 delegates.

zh.t: 2008年加利福尼亚州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州民主党总统初选于2008年2月5日“超级星期二”举行，提供的代表名额多于任何其他单场提名竞选。希拉里·克林顿以51.47%的得票率获胜，分得204个代表名额；贝拉克·奥巴马获得43.16%的选票，分得166个名额。

en.s: The 2008 Hawaii Republican presidential caucuses were held between January 25 and February 5, 2008. The caucuses chose delegates to Hawaii's Republican State Convention in May 2008, which overwhelmingly lent its support to presidential candidate John McCain.

zh.t: 2008年夏威夷州共和党总统党团会议
zh.s: 2008年夏威夷州共和党总统党团会议于1月25日至2月5日举行，选出参加当年5月州共和党大会的代表。州大会随后以压倒性多数支持总统候选人约翰·麦凯恩。

en.s: The 2008 Minnesota Democratic presidential caucuses took place on Super Tuesday, February 5, 2008 with 78 delegates at stake. The winner in each of Minnesota's eight congressional districts was awarded all of that district's delegates, totaling 47. Another 25 delegates were awarded to the statewide winner, Barack Obama. The 72 delegates represented Minnesota at the Democratic National Convention in Denver, Colorado.

zh.t: 2008年明尼苏达州民主党总统党团会议
zh.s: 明尼苏达州于2008年2月5日“超级星期二”举行民主党总统党团会议。原文开头称有78个代表名额可争夺，随后又写全州八个国会选区的胜者获得各区全部名额、合计47个，全州胜者贝拉克·奥巴马另获25个，共72名代表参加在科罗拉多州丹佛举行的民主党全国代表大会。原文两处总数不一致。

en.s: The 2008 Colorado Republican presidential caucuses took place on February 5, 2008, with two national delegates. Colorado chose 21 other delegates during district conventions from May 24 to June 7, 2008.

zh.t: 2008年科罗拉多州共和党总统党团会议
zh.s: 2008年科罗拉多州共和党总统党团会议于2月5日举行，涉及两个全国代表名额。该州另在5月24日至6月7日的选区大会中选出21名代表。

en.s: The 2008 Idaho Democratic presidential caucuses were held on Super Tuesday, February 5, 2008, with 18 national delegates at stake. For the first time, caucuses were held in all 44 counties, all of them open caucuses organized at the county level rather than the precinct level.

zh.t: 2008年爱达荷州民主党总统党团会议
zh.s: 2008年爱达荷州民主党总统党团会议于2月5日“超级星期二”举行，争夺18个全国代表名额。全州44个县首次全部举行党团会议，均为开放式会议，按县组织，而非按投票分区组织。

en.s: The 2008 Colorado Democratic presidential caucuses took place on Super Tuesday, February 5, 2008. As he did in every other state that held a caucus rather than a primary, Barack Obama won the caucus by a wide, two-to-one margin over Hillary Clinton.

zh.t: 2008年科罗拉多州民主党总统党团会议
zh.s: 科罗拉多州于2008年2月5日“超级星期二”举行民主党总统党团会议。贝拉克·奥巴马以约二比一的明显优势击败希拉里·克林顿。原文称，他在所有采用党团会议、而非初选投票形式的州也都获胜。

en.s: The 2008 Alaska Republican presidential caucuses were held on February 5, 2008, and has a total of 26 delegates at stake. Mitt Romney won the state, and, as the winner in Alaska's congressional district, was awarded all of that district's delegates. All results are from the presidential preference poll held at the caucuses.

zh.t: 2008年阿拉斯加州共和党总统党团会议
zh.s: 2008年阿拉斯加州共和党总统党团会议于2月5日举行，争夺26个代表名额。米特·罗姆尼赢得全州，并作为该州唯一国会选区的胜者，获得该区全部代表名额。所有结果均来自党团会议中的总统候选人意向投票。

en.s: The 2008 North Dakota Democratic presidential caucuses took place on February 5, 2008, one of the many Super Tuesday nominating contests held that day. Barack Obama won the caucuses, securing 8 out of 13 national delegates.

zh.t: 2008年北达科他州民主党总统党团会议
zh.s: 北达科他州于2008年2月5日举行民主党总统党团会议，是当天众多“超级星期二”提名竞选之一。贝拉克·奥巴马获胜，分得13个全国代表名额中的八个。

en.s: The 2008 North Dakota Republican presidential caucuses took place on February 5, 2008. Romney won with 8 of the 23 national delegates.

zh.t: 2008年北达科他州共和党总统党团会议
zh.s: 北达科他州于2008年2月5日举行共和党总统党团会议。罗姆尼获胜，分得23个全国代表名额中的八个。

en.s: The 2008 American Samoa Democratic presidential caucuses took place on February 5, 2008, also known as Super Tuesday. Caucusing began at 11:00 am local time. The early time ensured that results would be reported that evening in the mainland United States. Hillary Clinton won the caucus, the smallest of Super Tuesday's nominating contests. The caucus drew a record turnout for the territory.

zh.t: 2008年美属萨摩亚民主党总统党团会议
zh.s: 美属萨摩亚民主党总统党团会议于2008年2月5日“超级星期二”举行。会议在当地时间上午11时开始，以确保结果能在美国本土当晚公布。希拉里·克林顿赢得这场“超级星期二”规模最小的提名竞选，但当地参与人数创下纪录。

en.s: The 2008 Minnesota Republican presidential caucuses took place on February 5, 2008, with 38 national delegates at stake. The caucuses were considered a non-binding straw poll, since the Republican Party of Minnesota officially chose 24 delegates to the 2008 Republican National Convention during district conventions from May 3 to May 24, 2008, and the remaining 14 delegates during the state convention on June 7, 2008.

zh.t: 2008年明尼苏达州共和党总统党团会议
zh.s: 明尼苏达州于2008年2月5日举行共和党总统党团会议，涉及38个全国代表名额。不过，这次会议只是没有约束力的意向投票。州共和党在5月3日至24日的选区大会上，正式选出24名参加共和党全国代表大会的代表，并于6月7日州大会上选出其余14名代表。

en.s: The 2008 Alaska Democratic presidential caucuses took place Super Tuesday, February 5, 2008. This was the first time that Democrats in Alaska participated in Super Tuesday, and the large turnout forced at least one caucusing site to delay closing its doors far beyond the 6 p.m. deadline. The state had a total of 13 delegates at stake.

zh.t: 2008年阿拉斯加州民主党总统党团会议
zh.s: 阿拉斯加州于2008年2月5日“超级星期二”举行民主党总统党团会议，争夺13个代表名额。这是阿拉斯加州民主党首次参加“超级星期二”，参与者众多，至少一个会场被迫远超下午6时的截止时间才关门。

en.s: The 2008 Kansas Democratic presidential caucuses took held on Super Tuesday, February 5, 2008, with 21 delegates at stake. The remaining 11 delegates were selected at the Kansas Democratic Party District Conventions on April 12. The state, and a majority of its delegates, were won by Barack Obama.

zh.t: 2008年堪萨斯州民主党总统党团会议
zh.s: 堪萨斯州于2008年2月5日“超级星期二”举行民主党总统党团会议，争夺21个代表名额。其余11名代表于4月12日的州民主党选区大会中选出。贝拉克·奥巴马赢得全州，并分得多数代表名额。

en.s: The New York Republican presidential primary was held on February 5, 2008 (Super Tuesday). There were 101 delegates up for grabs for the candidates. The delegates were awarded on a winner-take-all basis, which means the winner, Arizona Senator John McCain, received all 101 delegates for the 2008 Republican National Convention.

zh.s: 2008年2月5日“超级星期二”，纽约州举行共和党总统初选。候选人争夺101名代表席位，采用胜者全得制。亚利桑那州参议员约翰·麦凯恩赢得初选，因此获得全部101名代表，出席2008年共和党全国代表大会。

en.s: The 2008 Georgia Democratic presidential primary took place on Super Tuesday, February 5, 2008, and had a total of 87 delegates at stake. The winner in each of Georgia's 13 congressional districts was awarded all of that district's delegates, totaling 57. Another 30 delegates were awarded to the statewide winner, Barack Obama. The 87 delegates represented Georgia at the Democratic National Convention in Denver, Colorado.

zh.t: 2008年佐治亚州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年2月5日“超级星期二”，佐治亚州举行民主党总统初选，共有87名代表席位待分配。该州13个国会选区的初选获胜者分别赢得所在选区全部代表，共57人。全州得票最高的巴拉克·奥巴马获得另外30名代表。佐治亚州的87名代表将出席在科罗拉多州丹佛举行的民主党全国代表大会。

en.s: The 2008 Georgia Republican presidential primary took place on February 5, 2008 (Super Tuesday), with 72 national delegates at stake. Mike Huckabee was the winner of the primary.

zh.t: 2008年佐治亚州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年2月5日“超级星期二”，佐治亚州举行共和党总统初选，共有72名全国代表席位待分配。迈克·赫卡比赢得初选。

en.s: The 2008 Alabama Republican presidential primary was held on February 5 (Super Tuesday) and had a total of 45 delegates at stake. The winner in each of the 7 congressional districts was awarded all of that district's delegates.

zh.t: 2008年阿拉巴马州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年2月5日“超级星期二”，阿拉巴马州举行共和党总统初选，共有45名代表席位待分配。州内7个国会选区各自的初选获胜者可获得该选区全部代表。

en.s: The 2008 Delaware Republican presidential primary was held on February 5 (Super Tuesday). A total of 18 delegates were selected. The Delaware Republican Party rallied behind John McCain, and he was the declared winner of the primary election after successfully taking all three Delaware counties. McCain was followed by Mitt Romney in second and then by Mike Huckabee in third.

zh.t: 2008年特拉华州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年2月5日“超级星期二”，特拉华州举行共和党总统初选，共选出18名代表。特拉华州共和党支持约翰·麦凯恩，他赢得全部3个县后被宣布为初选获胜者。米特·罗姆尼排名第二，迈克·赫卡比第三。

en.s: The 2008 Oklahoma Republican presidential primary was held on February 5, with 41 delegates at stake. It was a closed primary, meaning only registered Republicans could vote in the election. The primary was on Super Tuesday on the same day as twenty-three other states. John McCain won Oklahoma's primary with 37% of the vote, although Mike Huckabee picked up some delegate votes as well by receiving 33% of the vote.

zh.t: 2008年俄克拉何马州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年2月5日，俄克拉何马州举行共和党总统初选，共有41名代表席位待分配。这是一场封闭式初选，只有登记为共和党人的选民可以投票。初选在“超级星期二”举行，与另外23个州的竞选同日。约翰·麦凯恩以37%的选票赢得俄克拉何马州初选，迈克·赫卡比也获得33%的选票和部分代表票。

en.s: The 2008 Oklahoma Democratic presidential primary, part of the process of selecting that party's nominee for President of the United States, took place on February 5, one of the many nominating contests of 2008's "Super Tuesday". The primary election chose 38 pledged delegates to represent Oklahoma at the 2008 Democratic National Convention. The remainder of Oklahoma's 47 delegates consisted of unpledged superdelegates not bound by the results of the primary.

zh.t: 2008年俄克拉何马州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年2月5日，俄克拉何马州举行民主党总统初选，是该党总统候选人提名程序的一部分，也是“超级星期二”的多场提名竞选之一。初选选出38名承诺代表，代表俄克拉何马州参加2008年民主党全国代表大会。其余9名代表是无须遵循初选结果的超级代表。

en.s: The 2008 Libertarian Party presidential primaries allowed voters to indicate non-binding preferences for the Libertarian Party's presidential candidate. These differed from the Republican or Democratic presidential primaries and caucuses in that they did not appoint delegates to represent a candidate at the party's convention to select the party's nominee for the United States presidential election.

zh.s: 2008年自由意志党总统初选让选民表达对该党总统候选人的非约束性偏好。与共和党或民主党的总统初选和党团会议不同，自由意志党初选不会选出代表参加党代会，也不会由代表决定该党在美国总统选举中的提名人。

en.s: UFC 126: Silva vs. Belfort was a mixed martial arts pay-per-view event held by the Ultimate Fighting Championship on February 5, 2011, at the Mandalay Bay Events Center in Las Vegas, Nevada.

zh.s: UFC 126：席尔瓦对贝尔福特，是终极格斗冠军赛于2011年2月5日在美国内华达州拉斯维加斯曼德勒海湾活动中心举办的综合格斗按次付费赛事。

en.t: Gas terminal explosion near El-Arish disrupts supplies
en.s: On 5 February 2011, an explosion and fire struck a gas terminal near El-Arish in Egypt’s northern Sinai. Gas supplies were shut down. Initial reports disagreed over whether the cause was sabotage or a leak.
en.n: This records the pipeline incident on this date, not a confirmed start date for the entire Sinai insurgency.

zh.t: 阿里什附近天然气设施爆炸，供气中断
zh.s: 2011年2月5日，埃及西奈半岛北部阿里什附近的一处天然气设施发生爆炸并起火，供气随后关闭。最初的报道对原因说法不一，有的怀疑人为破坏，有的称是燃气泄漏。
zh.n: 此条记录当天的天然气管线事故，不将其视为整个西奈叛乱已经确定的起始日。

en.s: Guerra de Sexos (2012) (Spanish for "Battle of the Sexes") was the second annual Guerra de Sexos professional wrestling event produced by the International Wrestling Revolution Group. It took place on February 5, 2012, at Arena Naucalpan in Naucalpan, State of Mexico. The event title refers to the main event match, a steel cage match that featured male wrestlers, female wrestlers, Exótico wrestlers and Mini-Estrellas all competing against each other. The last person in the cage would be forced to either remove their wrestling mask, or if already unmask have their hair shaved off.

zh.s: 2012年性别大战是国际摔角革命集团举办的第二届同名年度职业摔角赛事，于2月5日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行。赛事名称来自当晚主赛：男选手、女选手、以夸张女性装扮出场的Exótico选手及迷你级选手共同参加钢笼赛。最后留在笼内的人必须摘下面具；若本就不戴面具，则须剃光头发。

en.s: The 2012 Kyoto mayoral election was held on February 5, 2012. The incumbent mayor Daisaku Kadokawa won over a candidate backed by the JCP with a margin of 31,794 votes. It was considered that his first term was generally appreciated by the voters.

zh.s: 2012年京都市长选举于2012年2月5日举行。时任市长门川大作以31,794票的优势击败日本共产党支持的候选人。选民普遍认可他首个任期的表现。

en.s: A second battle between the Syrian Army and the Free Syrian Army for control of the city of Rastan took place from 29 January to 5 February 2012. Located in Homs Governorate, Rastan is a city of 60,000 residents. The FSA captured Rastan after days of intense fighting, according to residents and the opposition.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2012年1月29日至2月5日，叙利亚政府军与叙利亚自由军为争夺拉斯坦控制权再次交战。拉斯坦位于霍姆斯省，人口约6万。据当地居民和反对派称，经过数日激战，叙利亚自由军攻占了拉斯坦。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Finland in January and February 2012. The first round took place on 22 January 2012 with advance voting between 11 and 17 January. Since no candidate received a majority of the vote, a second round was held on 5 February, with advance voting between 25 and 31 January. Sauli Niinistö was elected the President of Finland for a term from 1 March 2012 until 1 March 2018.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 芬兰于2012年1月和2月举行总统选举。第一轮于2012年1月22日举行，提前投票时间为1月11日至17日。由于没有候选人获得过半选票，第二轮于2月5日举行，提前投票时间为1月25日至31日。绍利·尼尼斯托当选芬兰总统，任期从2012年3月1日至2018年3月1日。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第二轮投票日期。

en.s: From 2013 to 2017, the United States deployed special operations forces and unmanned aerial vehicles in Niger to support the Nigerien government and French military in counter-terrorism operations against militant groups as part of Operation Juniper Shield. The deployment of U.S. forces in Niger and in the greater West Africa region involved the training of host nation partner forces, enhancement of host nation security assistance efforts, and facilitated counter-terrorism and surveillance and reconnaissance missions in support of host nation partner forces.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2013年至2017年，美国向尼日尔派遣特种作战部队和无人机，支持尼日尔政府及法国军队打击武装组织。这些行动属于“杜松之盾”行动的一部分。美国在尼日尔及更广泛的西非地区部署部队，包括培训东道国伙伴部队、加强安全援助，并支持反恐、监视和侦察任务。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: Operation Martyr Muath (Arabic: عملية الشهيد معاذ) was a 3-day series of airstrikes by the Royal Jordanian Air Force on Islamic State targets in response to the execution of the pilot Muath Al-Kasasbeh, who was burned alive.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: “烈士穆阿兹”行动（阿拉伯语：عملية الشهيد معاذ）是约旦皇家空军对“伊斯兰国”目标实施的一系列空袭，持续3天，以回应飞行员穆阿兹·卡萨斯贝被活活烧死。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 2017 Africa Cup of Nations final was an association football match to determine the winner of the 2017 Africa Cup of Nations, organised by the Confederation of African Football (CAF). The match was held at the Stade de l'Amitié in Libreville, Gabon, on 5 February 2017 and was contested by Cameroon and Egypt.

zh.s: 2017年非洲国家杯决赛于2月5日在加蓬利伯维尔友谊体育场举行，由喀麦隆与埃及争夺冠军。这项赛事由非洲足联主办。

en.s: The 2017 Graz local election was held on 5 February 2017 to elect the members of the Gemeindesrat of Graz. The Austrian People's Party (ÖVP) were the clear winners of the election, remaining the largest party with 38% of the vote. The Communist Party of Austria (KPÖ) remained the second largest party with 20%, while the Freedom Party of Austria (FPÖ) rose to third place.

zh.s: 2017年2月5日，格拉茨举行地方选举，选出市议会成员。奥地利人民党（ÖVP）以38%的得票率明显领先，继续保持第一大党地位。奥地利共产党（KPÖ）以20%维持第二位，自由党（FPÖ）升至第三位。

en.s: A special election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on February 5, 2019, to elect a new senator for District 11 in the Minnesota Senate, caused by the resignation of Democratic–Farmer–Labor (DFL) Senator Tony Lourey effective on January 3, 2019, to be appointed as commissioner of human services in Governor Tim Walz's cabinet. A primary election was held on January 22, 2019, to nominate a DFL candidate.

zh.t: 2019年明尼苏达州参议院第11选区特别选举
zh.s: 美国明尼苏达州于2019年2月5日举行州参议院第11选区特别选举。民主—农民—劳工党参议员托尼·劳里于1月3日辞职，出任州长蒂姆·沃尔兹内阁的公共服务厅长，议席因而出缺。该党于1月22日举行候选人初选。

en.t: Pope Francis celebrates Mass in Abu Dhabi
en.s: On 5 February 2019, Pope Francis celebrated Mass at Zayed Sports City in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, during his visit to the country.

zh.t: 方济各在阿布扎比主持弥撒
zh.s: 2019年2月5日，教皇方济各在访问阿拉伯联合酋长国期间，于阿布扎比扎耶德体育城主持弥撒。

en.s: Pegasus Airlines Flight 2193 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from İzmir to Istanbul in Turkey operated by Pegasus Airlines. On 5 February 2020, the Boeing 737-800 operating the route skidded off the runway while landing at Istanbul-Sabiha Gökçen International Airport, Turkey. Three people were killed, 179 people were injured, and the aircraft was destroyed. This was the first fatal accident in the airline's history.

zh.s: 飞马航空2193号班机是从伊兹密尔飞往伊斯坦布尔的土耳其国内定期客运航班。2020年2月5日，执行该航班的波音737-800客机在伊斯坦布尔萨比哈·格克琴国际机场降落时冲出跑道。机上3人死亡、179人受伤，飞机报废。这是该航空公司历史上首起致命事故。

en.s: The attempted assassination of Bai Yingneng was the first attack by the Myanmar National Democratic Alliance Army (MNDAA) on Tatmadaw-aligned Kokang Border Guard Forces in Kokang, Myanmar. On February 5, 2021, MNDAA fighters ambushed a convoy transporting ousted governor Bai Yingneng (Chinese: 白应能, also known as Khin Maung Lwin), the son of former Kokang leader Bai Suocheng, killing nine civilians and three of Bai's bodyguards.

zh.s: 2021年2月5日，缅甸民族民主同盟军在果敢伏击运送被免职行政长官白应能、又名钦貌伦的车队，造成九名平民和白应能的三名保镖死亡。白应能是前果敢领导人白所成之子。这是同盟军首次袭击与缅甸国防军结盟的果敢边防部队。

en.s: On February 5, 2021, local time, BKFC KnuckleMania took place at the RP Funding Center in Lakeland, Florida, United States.
en.n: February 5 is the local event date. Coverage published in UTC and the current promoter page may show February 6.

zh.t: BKFC首届KnuckleMania赛事在莱克兰举行
zh.s: 2021年2月5日，按当地时间，BKFC首届KnuckleMania裸拳格斗赛在美国佛罗里达州莱克兰的RP Funding Center举行。
zh.n: 2月5日为当地比赛日期。按协调世界时发布的报道及主办方现有页面可能标为2月6日。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Hermansson vs. Strickland
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Hermansson vs. Strickland (also known as UFC Fight Night 200, UFC on ESPN+ 58 and UFC Vegas 47) was a mixed martial arts (MMA) event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on February 5, 2022 at the UFC Apex facility in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Metropolitan Area, United States.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：赫尔曼松对斯特里克兰
zh.s: “UFC格斗之夜：赫尔曼松对斯特里克兰”也称UFC格斗之夜200、UFC ESPN+58或UFC拉斯维加斯47，是终极格斗冠军赛于2022年2月5日举办的综合格斗赛事，地点在美国内华达州恩特普赖斯的UFC Apex场馆，属于拉斯维加斯都会区。

en.s: The 2021 FFA Cup final was the final match of the 2021 FFA Cup, Australia's main soccer cup competition. It was contested between Melbourne Victory and Central Coast Mariners on 5 February 2022 at the AAMI Park in Melbourne. The 2021 final was the first since the 2019 FFA Cup Final, after the 2020 FFA Cup was cancelled due to the COVID-19 pandemic in Australia.

zh.s: 2021年澳大利亚足球杯决赛是该届赛事的最后一场比赛，由墨尔本胜利队对阵中央海岸水手队。比赛于2022年2月5日在墨尔本的AAMI公园举行。2020年澳大利亚足球杯因新冠疫情取消后，这是自2019年决赛以来首次举办决赛。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Cyprus on 5 February 2023. No candidate received a majority of the vote in the first round, so a runoff was held on 12 February. Incumbent president Nicos Anastasiades of the Democratic Rally (DISY), who won the presidential elections in 2013 and 2018, was ineligible to run due to the two-term limit mandated by the Constitution of Cyprus.

zh.s: 塞浦路斯于2023年2月5日举行总统选举。由于首轮无人获得过半选票，又于2月12日举行第二轮投票。民主大会党的现任总统尼科斯·阿纳斯塔夏季斯曾在2013年和2018年当选，受宪法规定的两届任期限制，不能再次参选。

en.s: General elections were held in Monaco on 5 February 2023. The result was a landslide victory for the governing Monegasque National Union led by Brigitte Boccone-Pagès, which won all 24 seats on the National Council. The new council was sworn in on 16 February.

zh.s: 摩纳哥于2023年2月5日举行大选。布丽吉特·博科纳-帕热领导的执政摩纳哥民族联盟取得压倒性胜利，包揽全国议会全部24席。新议会于2月16日宣誓就职。

en.s: The 2023 Rey de Reyes (Spanish for "2023 King of Kings") was a professional wrestling tournament and supercard event produced by the Mexican Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA) promotion. The event was held on February 5, 2023, at Poliforum Zamna in Merida, Yucatan, Mexico. The 2023 event was the 26th Rey de Reyes show and tournament.

zh.s: 2023年王中之王是墨西哥AAA全球摔角组织举办的职业摔角锦标赛及大型赛事，于2023年2月5日在墨西哥尤卡坦州梅里达萨姆纳综合体育馆举行。这是第26届王中之王赛事及锦标赛。

en.s: The 44th Yokohama Film Festival (第44回ヨコハマ映画祭) was held on 5 February 2023.

zh.s: 第44届横滨电影节于2023年2月5日举行。

en.s: Legislative Assembly elections were held in Delhi on 5 February 2025 to elect all 70 members of the Delhi Legislative Assembly. The counting of votes and declaration of results took place on 8 February 2025. The Bharatiya Janata Party won in 48 out of 70 seats, thus returning to power in Delhi after 27 years. Rekha Gupta, the MLA from Shalimar Bagh, took oath as the Chief Minister on 20 February 2025.

zh.s: 德里于2025年2月5日举行议会选举，改选全部70席，并于2月8日计票、公布结果。印度人民党赢得48席，时隔27年重新在德里执政。沙利马尔巴格选区议员雷卡·古普塔于2月20日宣誓出任首席部长。
